info.title: empg
info.description: Command line tool for creating, inspecting and managing embedded PostgreSQL instances.

commands.name: archive
commands.description: Stop a cluster and archive its data directory.

options.name: --cluster
options.description: Cluster to archive. Required when the instance has more than one.

options.name: --mode
options.description: Shutdown mode used before archiving: Smart, Fast or Immediate. Choices: "Smart", "Immediate", "Fast". Default: <Fast>.

options.name: --instance
options.description: Registered instance to act on. Defaults to the active instance.

options.name: --directory
options.description: Act on the instance in this directory, registered or not.

options.name: --json
options.description: Emit machine-readable JSON instead of text. Default: <false>.

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Suppress informational output. Default: <false>.

options.name: --connect-timeout
options.description: Seconds to wait when connecting to a cluster before giving up. 0 waits indefinitely. Default: <10>.

options.name: --help
options.description: Shows help text. Default: <false>.

commands.name: add
commands.description: Add a data cluster to the instance.

options.name: --port
options.description: Port for the cluster. Omit to pick the first free port at or above --port-start. Default: <0>.

options.name: --port-start
options.description: Where automatic port selection begins when --port is omitted. Default: <5500>.

options.name: --data-directory
options.description: Data directory, relative to the instance. Defaults to the cluster name.

options.name: --superuser
options.description: Superuser name. Default: <postgres>.

options.name: --host
options.description: Address clients are told to connect to. Does not affect what the server binds to. Default: <localhost>.

options.name: --listen
options.description: Addresses the server binds to (listen_addresses), for example "localhost,192.168.1.10" or "*".

options.name: --durable
options.description: Run with fsync enabled. Turn off only for throwaway clusters. Default: <true>.

options.name: --encoding
options.description: Cluster encoding. Default: <UTF-8>.

options.name: --locale
options.description: Cluster locale.

options.name: --no-init
options.description: Register the cluster without running initdb. Default: <false>.
